builder_limits: route road width: 14 m default - an 18 m road (2 x 6 m lanes + 2 x 3 m edges) failed the kit walls-hold check on the test loop (earlier retail-look tests): wider retail carriageways are NOT reproduced
route banking <= ~0.3 deg (kit gate V2); start stretch level (grid written level)
closed circuits only (trackbuild); one AI route with 5 cyclic lanes; junctions / side roads are geometry only
materials opaque only: retail cut-out foliage / fences / signs cannot be used; trees are generated low-poly opaque shapes
scenery = geometry copies (no prop / instance writer): every lamp / building / tree counts in the unit slots (mesh 0x28000, LOD 0x18000 incl. full collision)
83 material rows per track; sky / fog / lighting = the donor track's enviro.dat unchanged
kind_evidence: tall vertical surfaces 26 % of the surface within 60 m (>= 20 %); NOTE: facades and cliffs / rock walls measure alike - check the source track before calling it a city
name_note: 'Waterfront' is the track's name in the Workbench retail guide (earlier retail-look tests: US/C1_V1 = US Waterfront); water itself is neither measured nor generated

palette_why.edge: road-surface texture with an across repeat of 3.00 m (about half the lane repeat)
palette_why.facades: the 4 largest opaque tall-vertical areas; repeat_m = mean of the measured u / v metres per repeat on vertical faces (None = not measured: 6 m used)
palette_why.foliage: greenest opaque ground-like texture by measured mean colour (g - (r + b) / 2 = 0.068)
palette_why.ground: largest opaque ground / terrain area (else the second verge texture)
palette_why.posts: opaque tall thin roadside instance models (>= 4.5 m, <= 1.6 m thick) by placements per km; WHAT they are (lamp, tram post, pylon) is not decoded - check the thumbnail
palette_why.road: largest opaque road-surface area (146623 m2) with a measured repeat
